description: Costs 0.001 USDC per call via x402. Returns the best route and an unsigned transaction, and for Solana swaps a rug-pull risk check of the output token (mint/freeze authority, token-2022 traps, holder concentration) so agents do not buy honeypots. Same-chain Solana swaps route through Jupiter with a referral fee account. Cross-chain and EVM swaps route through LI.FI with an integrator fee. The response contains a serialized unsigned transaction to be signed and broadcast by the caller. A 30 bps platform fee is embedded in the route.

amount.description: Input amount in base units (lamports, wei, 1e-6 USDC)

destinationAddress.description: Receiver on toChain; defaults to userAddress

inputToken.description: Token address/mint, or symbol (SOL, USDC, USDT, ETH)

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

userAddress.description: Wallet that signs the transaction on fromChain

name: swap_quote_and_build
